name: Local Citation Page Jump
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Save page-offset: -43 when printed page 44 is physical page 1, then jump from the citation.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Local Citation Page Jump is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it in your research notes.
